title: Fix the Maximum Finder
description: The program should define a function that returns the larger of two numbers. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 9, the larger of 3 and 9.
actualProblem: The fallback return statement after the if block always returns a, regardless of which value is actually larger. Since 3 is not greater than 9, the if branch is skipped and the function falls through to 'return a', incorrectly returning 3 instead of 9.
explanation: The fallback path (when a is not greater than b) needs to return b, the other candidate value, not repeat a. Returning the wrong variable silently produces incorrect results without any error being raised.
